sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification, Distracted driving, seat belts and child restraints

Section D records the accuracy posture for distracted driving, seat belts and child restraints. Every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 traces to exactly one cited physical handbook page, and that page states the fact in full. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned October edition of the handbook. No fact needed a lower confidence flag, so no verification debt was opened and no external review was requested. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, image or sample question is reproduced. Fine amounts, child age and height limits and the pickup bed speed limit are recorded exactly as printed in the pinned edition; no figure was taken from outside the handbook. No location-variable fact needed isolation as dynamic knowledge.
